keyVerseDR: "Be ye therefore merciful, as your Father also is merciful." (Lk 6:36)

level1.title: Be Kind to Everyone
level1.story: Jesus said, "Love your enemies. Do good to people who hate you." Be merciful, just as God is merciful. Treat others the way you want to be treated.
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
level1.heartLabelA: How I want to be treated
questions: Who can you be kind to?
level1.prayer: Jesus, help me be kind and merciful. Amen.

activity.title: Be merciful
activity.intro: Fill the Sacred Heart with mercy.

level2.title: Love Your Enemies
level2.story: Jesus said, "Love your enemies, do good to them that hate you. Bless them that curse you, and pray for them that calumniate you." He said to give to everyone who asks of you. "And as you would that men should do to you, do you also to them in like manner." Jesus said, "Be ye therefore merciful, as your Father also is merciful." He said, "Forgive, and you shall be forgiven. Give, and it shall be given to you."
level2.keyLine: Be ye therefore merciful, as your Father also is merciful.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: Why should we love our enemies?
What does 'the measure you give' mean?
actions: Pray for someone who hurt me
level2.prayer: Merciful Father, make me merciful. Amen.

activity.intro: Number the word cards in order.
